title: RBI Monetary Penalties on Three NBFCs - KYC and Fair Practice Code Violations
description: <cite index="54-5,54-6">The RBI imposed monetary penalties on three NBFCs by order dated August 3, 2026, including Rs 5.40 lakh on Infinity Fincorp Solutions Private Limited for non-compliance with KYC Directions and Fair Practice Code.</cite> <cite index="54-1">Rs 2.70 lakh was imposed on Namdev Finvest for non-compliance with KYC Directions.</cite> <cite index="52-10">Deficiencies included failure to timely review risk categorization and disclosure of interest rate determination.</cite>
